verdict.rationale: Extend ships a Parse product whose output is returned as `chunks` plus a `metadata` object, and it advertises detection of tables, checkboxes, images and handwriting, which suggests some structural segmentation. Nothing in the evidence confirms that headings, section hierarchy or reading order are preserved, so this is only glancing support. Missing for 10: documented heading/section hierarchy in parse output, explicit reading-order handling, an output-format spec (e.g., markdown/tree structure), independent or hands-on corroboration of structure fidelity.
